text: At 65 minutes, Kingsmoor FC changes their approach while positioned mostly in the middle third of the pitch near the left and right flanks. They press higher and increase the line height closer to Westport Albion’s goal at the far end of the field. The team plays more direct passes aiming quickly toward wide attacking areas near Westport's penalty box on the left and right sides. Despite these aggressive tactics, Kingsmoor’s attacking chances diminish while their turnovers increase in the central and wide zones [#1187].
